boundary: Tasks skipped by dependency selection retain historical results, not currently replayed proof. The complete integrated owner-bound chatbot is in a separate archive; the standalone finite checker does not authenticate owners.
next: Explore whether one freshly audited route certificate can be reused by multiple independent tasks without merging their requirements.
observation: A changed middle source re-audits only tasks that depend on that source; shared donor or final source changes reach every dependent task.
preserved: Each task keeps its own obligations and exact pinned source identity. Unaffected tasks stay cached until explicit proof-for-use.
summary: Separate route-bound tasks share a dependency network while preserving independent task evidence.
title: Multi-task source dependency propagation
